name: Hide in Plain Sight (Su)
body:
Prerequisite: Saboteur 8

Benefit: A saboteur with this trick can use the Stealth skill even while being observed. As long as she is within 10 feet of an area of dim light, a saboteur can hide herself from view in the open without anything to actually hide behind. She cannot, however, hide in her own shadow.
